cards.card_text: Then Paul turns to someone he calls 'my true yokefellow,' with no name attached.
cards.verse_text: Yes, and I ask you, my true yokefellow, to help these women who have contended at my side for the gospel, along with Clement and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the Book of Life.
